_meta.title: America's Cup match results
_meta.why: Sailing was scored from Olympic medals alone, so the oldest trophy in international sport counted for nothing. Ashwin asked for it in on 2026-09-04, with the explicit instruction that it should lift sailing a little rather than transform it, which is what the base points below are set to do.
_meta.attribution: The Cup is contested by yacht clubs, not countries, and a crew is usually multinational. The nation credited is the one the challenging or defending club represents, which is how the event itself is reported and the only attribution with a defensible rule behind it. Sailors' passports are deliberately not used: Team New Zealand has sailed with Australians and Oracle Team USA won with a New Zealand-born helmsman, and following the crew rather than the club would credit the wrong flag in both directions.
_meta.window: 1983 onward, the year the New York Yacht Club's 132-year hold ended. With an 8-year half-life nothing before that can move a ranking.
_meta.notHeldYet: The 38th match is scheduled for Naples in 2027 and is not in this file.
